title: Spoken reading for partially sighted users
symptom: A partially sighted user requests an easy way to hear their blood glucose reading and trend on demand, e.g., by pressing and holding the home button, because continuous speech every five minutes would be annoying.
fix: Tasker support was added in the Jan 1st Nightly, allowing speaking the current reading, switching speaking readings on/off, and switching speaking of alerts on/off via the 'SPEAK NOW' configuration button from tasker 3rd party plugins.
evidence_quote: The Jan 1st Nightly includes Tasker support for speaking the current reading, switching speaking readings on/off and also switching speaking of alerts on/off. See the `SPEAK NOW` configuration button from tasker 3rd party plugins and the other related ones.
